subject: Risk & Compliance
title: The Thucydides Trap
description: A quick, practical guide to The Thucydides Trap.

hook.text: A rising power threatens a ruling power. War becomes likely — not inevitable, but historically probable.

buildup.text: Graham Allison's Thucydides Trap theory warns that US-China rivalry mirrors 16 historical power transitions.

discovery.text: Of those 16 cases, 12 ended in war. The pattern spans from Athens vs Sparta to Germany vs Britain.

twist.text: The four cases that avoided war required extraordinary diplomatic skill and mutual economic dependence.

climax.text: US-China competition defines 21st-century geopolitical risk. Every business with global exposure must understand it.

punchline.text: Rising power. Ruling power. 12 of 16 times: war followed.

quiz.question: What is the Thucydides Trap?
options: The pattern where rising powers threaten ruling powers, often leading to war
